settings.hero_desc: An Interactive cutaway demonstration model of an anaerobic digester, showing the internal paddle agitators at work inside the tank, on a branded presentation base. Built for equipment makers and process firms to explain their technology at exhibitions and sales meetings.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your equipment, branding, base plaque and (optional) motorised demo
settings.s1_body: When you sell process equipment, a cutaway model does the explaining for you. This anaerobic-digester model opens the tank to reveal the paddle agitators inside, mounted on a branded base so prospects see exactly how your technology operates. Perfect for trade shows, sales meetings and reception displays - and we can build it as a static or motorised demonstration.
settings.case_heading: A Sales Tool That Explains Itself
settings.case_body: Built for CleanEdge Resources whose Digestor factory is located in India, this cutaway model let the sales team show prospects exactly how their digester agitators work - a tangible demo that landed far better than a brochure at exhibitions and client meetings.
settings.case_quote: Clients finally understood our product in seconds. It's the centrepiece of our exhibition stand now.
settings.case_quote_attr: Nitin - Country Manager of CleanEdge Resource
settings.prov_p: Buyers trust what they can see working. A cutaway demonstration model turns a complex internal process into a clear, physical story that wins technical confidence.
